exposes.name: Scale protection
exposes.description: If the heat sink is not fully opened within two weeks or is not used for a long time, the valve will be blocked due to silting up and the heat sink will not be able to be used. To ensure normal use of the heat sink, the controller will automatically open the valve fully every two weeks. It will run for 30 seconds per time with the screen displaying "Ad", then return to its normal working state again..

exposes.name: Frost protection
exposes.description: When the room temperature is lower than 5 °C, the valve opens; when the temperature rises to 8 °C, the valve closes..

exposes.name: Error
exposes.description: If NTC is damaged, "Er" will be on the TRV display..
